The main takeaway from our work is that
the asymptotic walk lengths at pseudocritical points depend on the rate of convergence to the pseudocritical point.

for sequences of fugacites that converge to the pseudocritical point at a sufficiently fast rate, the asymptotic walk-length is identical to that at the critical point, but for slower convergence rates the asymptotic walk lengths are different.

for any sequence of fugacities converging to the critical point at a rate faster than $n^{-1/2+\varepsilon}$, the asymptotic length is given by the mean-field value of the length at the critical point.
